title: Institute Lecture on ' How does insect flight cope with Miniaturization?' by Prof. Sanjay Sane
description:
Under IIT Delhi Institute Lecture Series, an online Webinar on 'Smaller Creatures, Bigger Questions: How does insect flight cope with miniaturization?' will be delivered by Prof. Sanjay Sane from the National Centre for Biological Sciences, Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Bangalore. Prof. Sane's talk  will touch upon some of the following questions:  How do insects cope with the challenges of miniaturization? How can we study such questions  in  a  laboratory  and  what  hypotheses emerge  that  can explain  their  ability  to  adapt  to  extreme miniaturization? Prof. Sane will also talk about the indescribable beauty and complexity of the architecture of the insect body, and the  lessons we can learn from Nature about miniaturization that can be applicable in our
own efforts to develop small flying robots.

chapters.title: Major Challenges That Insects Must Face When They Miniaturize
How Are Insects Able To Achieve Speed and Precision during Flight Control
The Biomechanics of Wing and Hotel Coordination in Flies
How Do Insects Achieve Control of Just One Wing at a Time
Wing Engagement at the Start of Flight
Additional Control of the Wing Hinge
The Video of a Fly Landing
How Long Do You Think It Will Take To Develop an Insect Based Uh Fully Controllable Mav
